extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Revenue-alignment MCP server: opportunity ledger, capability matching, Qompass/NTRanch lanes. Opportunities live in one of two lanes — Qompass (sfw) or NTRanch (nsfw) — and a caller scoped to one lane can never see the other lane's entries; the ledger lives on plain files under a data root. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Lupin does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Lupin

skills.description: List and fetch ledger entries (optionally filtered by status) and submit candidates into the scan inbox — submissions never write the ledger; lane scope is enforced on every read (opportunity_list, opportunity_get, opportunity_submit).
skills.name: Opportunity ledger

skills.description: The capability registry (the alignment vocabulary) and advisory keyword matching of free text against capabilities; matching never auto-aligns (capability_list, capability_match).
skills.name: Capability registry

skills.description: Counts by status and lane plus parse health — the value-demonstration view of the revenue pipeline (pipeline_summary).
skills.name: Pipeline summary
